title: a new number the owner would tune, or one idea under two names
question: Is a new number a limit or timeout the owner would tune (a setting), or one idea written twice under two names?

explain.what: A model read the diff and found a new number the owner would tune, or one idea written under two names.
explain.why: A buried limit cannot be tuned without a code change; two names for one idea drift apart.
explain.fix: Move the number to a setting with one name, or use one name for the idea everywhere. The second voice is in shadow: it warns only. Rate the finding (thumbs up or down) so its precision can be measured.
